stillCantConnect.intro: If your credentials above are correct, this is usually caused by qBittorrent rejecting the local connection. Try fixing it directly inside qBittorrent:
stillCantConnect.step2: Go to Tools > Options (or press Alt + O).
stillCantConnect.step3: Click the Web UI tab on the left.
stillCantConnect.step4a: Check "Bypass authentication for clients on localhost".
stillCantConnect.step4b: Check "Bypass authentication for clients in whitelisted IP subnets" and add 127.0.0.1/32 to the whitelist field.
stillCantConnect.step6: Completely close qBittorrent (exit via the system tray or Task Manager), then restart both qBittorrent and Ascendara.

stillCantConnect.vpnNote: If you use a VPN, proxy, or a tool like ExitLag, make sure it isn't rerouting your localhost traffic - exclude 127.0.0.1 and localhost or temporarily disable it while troubleshooting.
